test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.3.
solution:
The correct answer is 'traditional'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the **meaning **of the given options - 

 
 
• habitual - done constantly or as a habit.
 
• sanctioned - give official permission or approval for (an action).
 
• traditional - existing in or as part of a tradition; long-established.
 
• prescribed - recommend (a substance or action) as something beneficial.
 
 
 
• The given blank needs an adjective to describe the succeeding noun **crafts.**
 
• We can negate **sanctioned **and **prescribed **as both are verbs. 
 
• From the meanings of the remaining two words, it is clear that traditional fits the blank correctly. 
 
• Thus, option 3 is the correct answer. 

 

*Correct passage - **Concerned and responsible Indian citizens can encourage sensible consumption (1) behaviour. This can be done by shopping less and wasting (2) even lesser; by buying local products to keep the cottage industries and (3) traditional__ crafts alive. In essence, by valuing their rich(4) heritage and living simple and meaningful lives, Indians can set (5) a precedent and show the west that India is much more than a well of business opportunities.*
